title: LMS Learning Path Acceleration
scenario: Calculate the average acceleration of completion (speeding up or slowing down) between successive lessons for each student.
tableSchema: progress (stu_id INT, lesson_id INT, completion_date DATE)
hint: Calculate delta time between lessons, then delta of deltas.
correctQuery: SELECT stu_id, AVG(diff_delta) FROM (SELECT stu_id, (diff - LAG(diff) OVER(PARTITION BY stu_id ORDER BY completion_date)) as diff_delta FROM (SELECT stu_id, (completion_date - LAG(completion_date) OVER(PARTITION BY stu_id ORDER BY completion_date)) as diff FROM progress) t) t2 GROUP BY stu_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE progress (stu_id INT, lesson_id INT, completion_date DATE);
